papers.title: Effect of Sample Thickness and Post-Processing on Mechanical Properties of 3D-Printed Titanium Alloy
papers.abstract: 3D printing of beta titanium alloys for biomedical applications is currently in great demand, both for material reasons and for the possibility of producing very complex replacements, often directly tailored to the patient. Gyroidal and similar structures are ideal for biomedical replacements but their manufacturing require specific additive technology and post-processing like annealing or etching. The aim of this work is to determine the mechanical properties of Ti25Nb4Ta8Sn alloy which overcomes Ti6Al4V in biomedical applications. The results showed that Ti6Al4V exhibited a significantly higher ultimate tensile strength (up to 1200 MPa) compared with the beta titanium alloy Ti25Nb4Ta8Sn (up to 360 MPa), while the latter demonstrated a substantially lower elastic modulus (∼40-50 GPa), beneficial for biomedical applications. Annealing improved strength and reduced internal stresses in both alloys, while etching effectively removed residual powder but slightly decreased mechanical integrity. These findings provide a quantitative basis for optimizing printing and post-processing parameters of beta titanium alloys for implant design. The properties will be used for future numerical simulations of implants made from Ti25Nb4Ta8Sn alloy based on discrete particle grid models.

llm.relevance_to_user: 论文主要研究Ti25Nb4Ta8Sn合金，仅附带比较Ti-6Al-4V，不符合Ti-6Al-4V后处理控制的焦点。
llm.why_not_core: The paper's primary focus is on Ti25Nb4Ta8Sn alloy, not Ti-6Al-4V; it only peripherally compares Ti-6Al-4V, and thus does not contribute directly to post-processing control of Ti-6Al-4V.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究3D打印β钛合金Ti25Nb4Ta8Sn的力学性能，并与Ti6Al4V比较。
summary_zh.method: 通过拉伸试验评估不同样品厚度和退火、蚀刻后处理的影响。
summary_zh.result: Ti6Al4V抗拉强度高达1200MPa，而Ti25Nb4Ta8Sn弹性模量更低（40-50GPa）。
summary_zh.validation: 实验力学测试验证后处理对强度和模量的影响。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the mechanical properties of 3D-printed Ti25Nb4Ta8Sn alloy, a beta titanium alloy for biomedical applications, compared with Ti6Al4V.
summary_en.method: Tensile tests were performed on samples of varying thicknesses subjected to annealing and etching post-processing.
summary_en.result: Ti6Al4V showed significantly higher ultimate tensile strength (up to 1200 MPa) than Ti25Nb4Ta8Sn (up to 360 MPa), while the latter had a lower elastic modulus (40-50 GPa) beneficial for implants.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing validated the effects of annealing (improving strength) and etching (removing powder but reducing integrity).

papers.title: Fretting Behavior of Additively Manufactured Ti-6Al-4V: A Fretting Map Based Framework
papers.abstract: Additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V, fabricated by selective laser melting (SLM), was experimentally investigated under fretting conditions. Fretting tests were conducted by using a bridge-type configuration in accordance with ASTM E2789 on two specimens subjected to different normal loads. Damaged surfaces were examined by optical microscopy and scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and the observations were synthesized in the load-slip amplitude space to develop the fretting maps. Boundaries on these maps delineate contact regimes (stick/partial slip and gross slip) and identify crack prone regions. The results show that increasing slip amplitude shifted the response from fatigue prone regime to wear dominated behavior, consistent with oxide debris interlayer formation and surface smoothing that suppress crack nucleation. The resulting fretting maps provide a systematic basis for distinguishing fretting regimes and support the design and selection of surface engineering strategies appropriate to each regime.
papers.venue: international journal of advanced design and manufacturing technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对SLM制造的Ti-6Al-4V的微动行为，属于方向重点关注的力学性能范畴。
llm.why_not_core: No conventional tensile or S-N fatigue data, only fretting behavior under specific contact regimes.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM制造Ti-6Al-4V的微动磨损行为及其机制。
summary_zh.method: 采用桥型配置进行微动试验，结合光学显微镜和SEM分析损伤表面。
summary_zh.result: 滑移幅值增加导致从疲劳主导向磨损主导转变，绘制了微动图。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验数据构建微动图，识别接触区域和裂纹倾向区。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the fretting behavior of additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V and establish regime boundaries.
summary_en.method: Fretting tests using a bridge-type configuration per ASTM E2789 were conducted on SLM specimens at different normal loads, with surface inspection via optical microscopy and SEM.
summary_en.result: Increasing slip amplitude shifts the response from fatigue-dominated to wear-dominated behavior, consistent with oxide debris and surface smoothing that suppress crack nucleation.
summary_en.validation: Experimental observations were synthesized into fretting maps delineating stick, partial slip, and gross slip regimes along with crack-prone regions.
